item.title: [Exclusive] Ruling Party's 'Non-Myung' Group Choilhoe "We've Taken Down Our Sign" ([단독] 與 ‘비명횡사’ 모임 초일회 “간판 내렸습니다”)
item.description:
[Exclusive] Ruling Party's 'Non-Myung' Group Choilhoe "We've Taken Down Our Sign" ([단독] 與 ‘비명횡사’ 모임 초일회 “간판 내렸습니다”)

Choilhoe, a group of non-Myung faction members outside the National Assembly within the Democratic Party of Korea, has reportedly disbanded as of the 2nd. Choilhoe, meaning "to strive daily without losing one's original intention," was formed by former lawmakers who suffered so-called "non-Myung deaths" during the nomination process for the 2024 general election. (더불어민주당 비명계 원외 모임인 ‘초일회’가 최근 해체한 것으로 2일 알려졌다. 초일회는 ‘초심을 잃지 않고 매일 정진한다’는 뜻으로 2024년 총선 공천 과정에서 이른바 ‘비명횡사’ 한 전직 의원들이 만든 모임이다.)

Choilhoe reportedly held a disbandment ceremony in early May without any separate external notice. The decision was made to dissolve the group as part of unifying factions within the Democratic Party ahead of the first anniversary of the Lee Jae-myung administration and the June 3 local elections. Former lawmaker Yang Ki-dae, who served as the secretary of Choilhoe, said in a phone call with this newspaper, "We agreed that we, the Lee Jae-myung administration, and the Democratic Party all need to move forward, so we disbanded. It was truly a stormy period back then (during the 2024 general election), but we reached a consensus that we shouldn't just linger in the past." Another former lawmaker who was a member of the group also stated, "We thought we shouldn't become like lawmakers secretly sharpening blades of revenge. We shared the sentiment of contributing to creating a better Korea when the Democratic Party takes power." (초일회는 지난 5월 초 별도의 외부 공지 없이 해단식을 가졌다고 한다. 이재명 정부 출범 1년과 6·3 지방선거를 앞두고 민주당 계파 통합 차원에서 모임을 없애기로 한 것이다. 초일회 간사를 맡았던 양기대 전 의원은 이날 본지 통화에서 “우리도, 이재명 정부도, 민주당도 앞으로 나아가야한다는 데 뜻이 일치해 해산했다”며 “그 때(2024년 총선)는 정말 폭풍의 시기였지만, 그렇다고 과거에만 계속 머물러서도 안되지 않겠냐는 데 공감대를 이뤘다”고 했다. 이 모임 소속이었던 한 전직 의원도 “숨어서 복수의 칼날을 가는 의원들처럼 돼선 안된다고 생각했다”면서 “민주당이 정권을 잡았을 때 더 좋은 대한민국을 만드는 데 기여하자는 마음이 통했다”고 했다.)

The Choilhoe members included around 15 people, such as former lawmakers Park Kwang-on, Park Yong-jin, Song Kap-seok, Kang Byung-won, Yang Ki-dae, Yoon Young-chan, Kim Chul-min, and Shin Dong-geun, who were classified as part of the pro-Moon and non-Myung factions. They had been meeting about once a month since the general election, offering critical remarks about controversies such as the alleged "sadaehwa" (turning the party into a personal fiefdom) during President Lee Jae-myung's tenure as party leader. At the time, Choilhoe had told President Lee to "let go of vested interests" and that "the disapproval rating is hindering the Democratic Party's power transition." In response to such criticism from within the party, President Lee had attempted to create points of contact with them through senior presidential secretaries for political affairs after taking office. (초일회 멤버는 친문 등 비명계로 분류됐던 박광온·박용진·송갑석·강병원·양기대·윤영찬·김철민·신동근 전 의원 등 15명 안팎이다. 이들은 총선 이후 매달 한 차례 정도 만나며 이재명 대통령의 당대표 시절 사당화 논란 등에 쓴소리를 해왔다. 당시 초일회는 이 대통령을 향해 “기득권을 내려놔라” “비호감도가 민주당 정권교체 발목을 잡고 있다”고 했었다. 당내에서 이런 비판이 나오자 이 대통령도 정부 출범 이후 정무수석 등을 통해 이들과의 접점을 만들려고 한 바 있다.)

In fact, President Lee reportedly appointed former lawmaker Park Yong-jin, a Choilhoe member, as the vice chairman of the presidential Regulatory Rationalization Committee, a cabinet-level position, in March, and this decision is known to have influenced the dissolution of Choilhoe. A Choilhoe insider said, "The appointment of former lawmaker Park was a surprising move. It seems a sentiment formed that it was difficult to maintain the group any longer, judging that the president was making an effort to embrace even the non-Myung faction." (실제 이 대통령은 지난 3월 초일회 멤버인 박용진 전 의원을 총리급의 대통령 직속 규제합리화위원회 부위원장에 발탁했는데, 이런 결정도 초일회 해체에 영향을 준 것으로 알려졌다. 한 초일회 관계자는 “박 전 의원의 기용은 깜짝 놀랄만한 일이었다”며 “대통령이 비명계까지 포용하려고 노력하고 있다는 판단에 더는 모임을 유지하기 힘들다는 기류가 형성됐던 것 같다”고 했다.)

A source from the ruling party commented, "Isn't the dissolution of Choilhoe a result of President Lee Jae-myung's will for party unity? President Lee's meeting with former President Moon Jae-in on the 1st is in the same context." There are also predictions within the ruling party that President Lee will accelerate efforts to improve relations with pro-Moon and non-Myung figures going forward. (여권 관계자는 “초일회 해산은 이재명 대통령의 당내 통합 의지가 통한 결과 아니겠냐”면서 “이 대통령이 지난 1일 문재인 전 대통령을 만난 것도 같은 맥락”이라고 했다. 여권에서는 이 대통령이 앞으로 친문·비명계 인사들과의 관계 개선에 더 속도를 낼 것이란 전망도 나온다.)

item.title: Ruling Party Holds Single-Party Judiciary Committee Meeting, Begins Unilateral Operation of Standing Committees: "100 Bills to Be Tabled on the 7th" (與, 단독 법사위 열어… 상임위 일방운영 시작 “7일엔 법안 100건 상정”)
item.description:
Ruling Party Holds Single-Party Judiciary Committee Meeting, Begins Unilateral Operation of Standing Committees: "100 Bills to Be Tabled on the 7th" (與, 단독 법사위 열어… 상임위 일방운영 시작 “7일엔 법안 100건 상정”)

As the Democratic Party of Korea (DPK) unilaterally elected the chairs of standing committees for the second half of the 22nd National Assembly without agreement from the opposition party, it held a single-party meeting of the Legislation and Judiciary Committee on the 2nd, unilaterally processing various agendas. This marks the start of standing committee operations while the People Power Party (PPP) is boycotting parliamentary schedules in protest of National Assembly Speaker Woo Won-shik's forced assignment of committees. (더불어민주당이 야당과 합의 없이 22대 국회 후반기 상임위원장 선출을 강행한 가운데, 2일 국회 법제사법위원회를 단독으로 열고 각종 안건을 일방 처리했다. 국민의힘이 조정식 국회의장의 상임위 강제 배치에 반발하며 국회 일정을 보이콧하고 있는 상황에서 상임위 운영을 시작한 것이다.)

At the full committee meeting of the Judiciary Committee, chaired by DPK member Seo Young-kyo, the committee decided on the appointment of secretaries and the formation of the First Subcommittee for Bill Review. Only lawmakers from the DPK, the Rebuilding Korea Party, and the Progressive Party attended, with PPP members absent. Lawmaker Kim Seung-won, a former judge, was appointed as the DPK's secretary for the Judiciary Committee. Chairwoman Seo stated, "I urge the PPP to quickly join us. Our train is moving as scheduled," adding, "At the next meeting on the 7th, we will table approximately 100 bills—50 unique to the Judiciary Committee and 50 from other standing committees." The DPK plans to soon discuss revisions to the Criminal Procedure Act, which the PPP opposes, regarding the abolition of the prosecution's supplementary investigative powers. (민주당 소속 서영교 법사위원장은 이날 법사위 전체회의를 열어 간사 선임과 법안심사1소위원회 구성의 건을 의결했다. 회의에는 민주당과 조국혁신당·진보당 등 범여권 의원만 참석하고 국민의힘 의원들은 모두 불참했다. 법사위 민주당 간사에는 판사 출신 김승원 의원이 선임됐다. 서 위원장은 “국민의힘도 빨리 들어와서 함께하길 촉구한다. 우리들의 열차는 그대로 시간 맞춰 간다”며 “7일에 다음 회의를 열어 법사위 고유 법안 50개와 타 상임위 법안 50개 등 약 100건의 법안을 상정하겠다”고 했다. 민주당은 법사위에서 국민의힘 등이 반대하고 있는 검찰 보완수사권 폐지에 관한 형사소송법 개정안 등을 조만간 논의할 예정이다.)

The PPP held a general meeting of lawmakers on the same day, expressing opposition to the DPK's unilateral election of 11 standing committee chairs, including that of the Judiciary Committee, and resolved not to cooperate at all with the formation of the legislative body, including future standing committee activities. Floor Leader Jung Jeom-sik told reporters, "We concluded that we cannot cooperate with the formation of the legislative body under these circumstances," adding, "We have no choice but to move forward with stronger resistance." He further claimed, "Why would the DPK not give us the Judiciary Committee? It's to pass a 'special prosecution law for the cancellation of indictments' to cancel the trials of President Lee Jae-myung. They appointed Seo Young-kyo as chair of the Judiciary Committee because they expect her to quickly pass that special prosecution law." (국민의힘은 이날 의원총회를 열고 민주당이 법제사법위원장을 포함한 11개 상임위원장을 단독으로 선출한 것에 반발하며 향후 상임위 활동 등 원 구성에 전혀 협조하지 않겠다는 방침을 세웠다. 정점식 원내대표는 기자들과 만나 “이 상태로는 원 구성에 협조할 수 없다는 결론을 내렸다”며 “앞으로 더 강한 투쟁을 통해 나아갈 수밖에 없다”고 밝혔다. 이어 “민주당이 법사위를 왜 안 주겠나. 이재명 대통령의 재판 취소를 위한 ‘공소취소 특검법’을 통과시키기 위한 것”이라며 “서영교 의원을 법사위원장으로 정한 것 역시 해당 특검법을 신속하게 통과시켜 줄 것을 기대했기 때문”이라고 했다.)

Meanwhile, regarding the South Korean national football team's elimination from the group stage of the 2026 North and Central America World Cup after a poor performance, the DPK is also considering holding a hearing at the National Assembly's Culture, Sports and Tourism Committee by summoning Korea Football Association President Chung Mong-gyu and former national team head coach Hong Myung-bo as witnesses. A DPK official stated, "If the opposition party does not respond to requests to participate in the standing committee, the DPK could hold a single-party meeting of the Culture, Sports and Tourism Committee." However, it was reported that former coach Hong left for the United States again on the same day, just two days after returning to South Korea. (한편 민주당은 한국 축구 대표팀이 2026 북중미 월드컵 조별리그에서 졸전 끝에 탈락한 것과 관련해, 국회 문화체육관광위원회에서 정몽규 대한축구협회장과 홍명보 전 대표팀 감독 등을 증인으로 불러 청문회를 여는 방안도 검토하기로 했다. 민주당 관계자는 “야당이 상임위 참여 요청에 응하지 않을 경우 민주당이 단독으로 문체위 회의를 열 수도 있다”고 했다. 다만 홍 전 감독은 귀국 이틀 만인 이날 다시 미국으로 출국한 것으로 알려졌다.)

item.title: NEC’s ‘Campaign to Save Wi Cheol-hwan’… Internal Document Drafted to Counter Calls for Resignation (선관위의 ‘위철환 살리기’… 사퇴론 대응 문건 만들었다)
item.description:
NEC’s ‘Campaign to Save Wi Cheol-hwan’… Internal Document Drafted to Counter Calls for Resignation (선관위의 ‘위철환 살리기’… 사퇴론 대응 문건 만들었다)

As the People Power Party (PPP) calls for the resignation and impeachment of Wi Cheol-hwan, acting chair of the National Election Commission (NEC), it has emerged that the NEC prepared an internal document outlining reasons why the acting chair should not step down. The document argues that the resignation of a commissioner would “weaken accountability” and suggests retaining all commissioners, including Wi, as a countermeasure. This document was submitted to Wi ahead of his appearance before the National Assembly. Separately, it has been confirmed that three days after President Lee Jae-myung ordered a joint police-prosecutor investigation into the NEC, the commission formed a 16-person, three-team task force in response. <<> The document is a three-page report titled “Review of the Resignation of All Commissioners,” prepared by the NEC’s Office of Agenda Management on June 29. It was drafted to assess the situation and propose responses after the PPP demanded that Wi decide his fate before the second institutional report (July 1) of the National Assembly’s Special Committee on State Audit. The document states that “a specific political party is demanding accountability by citing the acting commissioner’s past record, questioning political neutrality and fairness, and blaming him for supervisory negligence over the ballot shortage.” Wi is a fellow graduate of the Judicial Research and Training Institute with President Lee Jae-myung and previously served as head of the Ethics Committee for the Democratic Party of Korea. <<> The document notes that some have argued Wi should resign on the grounds that “it is inappropriate and unfair for a standing commissioner to serve as acting chair.” After the ballot shortage incident on June 5, then-chair Noh Tae-ak resigned, and Wi assumed the acting role. In response, the document argues: “Given that all commissioners and staff have been accused and are under investigation, any acting chair would face the same scrutiny regardless of who holds the position.” <<> It also identifies “weakened commission accountability due to limitations in focusing on duties if a part-time commissioner serves as acting chair” as a problem if a standing commissioner resigns. As a countermeasure, it suggests “retaining all commissioners, including the acting chair,” stating that “uniting efforts for election system and NEC organizational reform is the responsible action for commissioners.” <<> The document was prepared by the NEC’s Office of Agenda Management, which supports the commission under Wi’s leadership. An NEC official said, “Given discussions in the National Assembly about the acting chair’s resignation and impeachment, we reviewed legal procedures, and the report was shared with the acting chair and all commissioners.” The office of PPP lawmaker Kim Eun-hye requested printing logs from Wi’s office computer, which led to the discovery and receipt of the document. <<> It has also been confirmed that after Wi assumed the acting role, the NEC established a “Local Election Follow-up Task Force.” On June 10, the NEC formed a three-team, 16-person task force led by the head of the Planning and Coordination Office. Three days earlier, on June 7, President Lee had ordered a joint police-prosecutor investigation into the NEC. The task force’s operational plan states that its “basic direction is defensive and reactive operations, rather than self-reform or institutional improvement.” Key tasks include coordinating National Assembly data requests, real-time media monitoring and response, and tracking the progress of police and prosecutor investigations. <<> PPP lawmaker Kim Eun-hye (Bundang-gu, Seongnam, Gyeonggi) stated, “Standing Commissioner Wi Cheol-hwan, who abandoned responsibility for election management, is using his acting authority to turn the NEC into a shield,” adding, “A special counsel for the NEC and impeachment of acting chair Wi are unavoidable.” PPP lawmaker Seo Beom-su (Ulju-gun, Ulsan), secretary of the Special Committee on State Audit, said, “We plan to propose an impeachment motion against Standing Commissioner Wi Cheol-hwan at the party level as early as next week.” For the impeachment motion to pass the National Assembly, it requires approval from a majority of sitting lawmakers, necessitating some support from the Democratic Party. <<> Meanwhile, on the 2nd, the National Assembly’s Special Committee on State Audit conducted an on-site inspection at the Olympic Handball Gymnasium in Songpa-gu, Seoul. The venue was used as a vote-counting station during the local elections but had been closed for 27 days due to protests by citizens demanding an investigation into the ballot shortage. With police assistance, committee members entered and conducted a 40-minute inspection. They confirmed that approximately 380 ballot boxes from Songpa-gu, containing 2.47 million ballots, as well as voting and counting records, were stored in a basement office but had not been removed. However, no ballot boxes were opened nor ballot counts verified on-site. Democratic Party members of the committee argued for moving the ballot boxes to a secure location, but PPP members countered, saying, “Moving them recklessly could create greater misunderstandings. We need to first check for blind spots in security cameras.” (국민의힘이 위철환 중앙선거관리위원장 직무대행(상임위원)의 사퇴와 탄핵을 주장하는 가운데, 중앙선관위가 위 직무대행이 사퇴해선 안 되는 이유를 담은 대응 문건을 작성한 것으로 나타났다. 문건에는 위원 사퇴 시 ‘책임성 약화’가 문제라며, 위 직무대행을 비롯한 선관위원 ‘전원 유임’을 대응 방안으로 제시했다. 이 문건은 국회 출석에 앞서 위 직무대행에게 보고됐다. 이와 별개로 이재명 대통령이 선관위에 대한 검경 합동 수사를 지시한 지 3일 후 중앙선관위가 3팀 16명 규모로 대응 태스크포스(TF)를 꾸린 사실도 확인됐다.)

item.title: President Lee: "Lee Jae-yong's Decision Reminds Me of the Late Chairman Lee Byung-chul's Tokyo Declaration" (李대통령 “이재용 결단, 故 이병철 회장의 도쿄 선언 떠올라”)
item.description:
President Lee: "Lee Jae-yong's Decision Reminds Me of the Late Chairman Lee Byung-chul's Tokyo Declaration" (李대통령 “이재용 결단, 故 이병철 회장의 도쿄 선언 떠올라”)

President Lee Jae-myung attended the "National Report Meeting on the Vision for Advanced Industry Development in the Chungcheong Region" held in Asan, South Chungcheong Province on the 2nd, and stated, "Earlier, while listening to Chairman Lee Jae-yong (of Samsung Electronics), I was reminded of the historic moment when the late Chairman Lee Byung-chul declared Samsung's entry into the semiconductor industry in Tokyo in 1983." He added, "Just as that foresight turned South Korea into a semiconductor powerhouse, I am confident that Chairman Lee's decision today will lead a new leap forward for South Korea's advanced industries." Following the previous event in Gwangju (June 30th) as part of the regional schedule for the "Three Mega Projects for South Korea's Great Leap," the meeting held at Samsung Display's Asan plant on this day was also attended by Chairman Lee Jae-yong. (이재명 대통령은 2일 충남 아산시에서 열린 ‘충청권 첨단산업 발전 비전 국민 보고회’에 참석해 “앞서 이재용 (삼성전자) 회장님 말씀을 들으며 고 이병철 회장께서 1983년 도쿄에서 반도체 산업 진출을 선언하셨던 역사적 순간이 떠올랐다”며 “그날의 선견지명이 대한민국을 반도체 강국으로 만들었듯이, 오늘 이 회장님의 결단이 대한민국 첨단 산업의 새로운 도약을 선도할 것이라 확신한다”고 말했다. 지난달 29일 청와대에서 열린 ‘대한민국 대도약 3대 메가 프로젝트’의 권역별 후속 일정으로 광주(6월 30일)에 이어 삼성디스플레이 아산사업장에서 열린 이날 행사에는 이재용 회장도 참석했다.)

Samsung plans to invest 140 trillion won in the Chungcheong region in areas such as organic light-emitting diodes (OLED), high-bandwidth memory (HBM), batteries, and package substrates. Chairman Lee Jae-yong stated on this day, "Chungcheong, the heart of the nation, will achieve greater growth as a global hub for IT materials and components." The total investment plans for the Chungcheong region from Samsung, SK, and Celltrion amount to 392 trillion won. (삼성은 앞으로 충청권에 유기발광다이오드(OLED)·고대역폭 메모리(HBM)·배터리·패키지 기판 등 140조원을 투자하기로 했다. 이재용 회장은 이날 “국토의 중심 충청은 앞으로 IT 소재 부품의 글로벌 허브로서 더 큰 성장을 이뤄갈 것”이라고 말했다. 삼성, SK, 셀트리온 등의 충청권 투자 계획은 총 392조원에 달한다.)

At the report meeting, President Lee read from a manuscript equivalent to four sheets of A4 paper, mentioning 'Chungcheong' 15 times. However, before that, he spent about 10 minutes refuting criticism that he had pressured Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix to secure large-scale investments in the Honam region. President Lee said, "In today's world, where would companies move to just because someone applies pressure?" and "Occasionally, there are people with outdated ideas who think that I pressed Chairman Lee Jae-yong to make this decision." He added, "Local government heads seem to get stressed when they face criticism like, 'Why not our town?' But even so, we must not take a divisive approach," and emphasized, "It's not about handing out gifts." (이 대통령은 이날 보고회에서 A4 용지 4장 분량의 원고를 낭독하며 ‘충청’을 15차례 언급했다. 다만 그에 앞서 10여 분간 삼성전자와 SK하이닉스를 압박해 대규모 호남 투자를 이끌어낸 것 아니냐는 비판에 반박했다. 이 대통령은 “요즘 세상에 압력을 넣는다고 기업들이 옮겨오는 데가 어디 있느냐”며 “제가 이재용 회장을 압박해서 삼성전자가 이런 결정을 한 것 아니냐는 구태적 생각을 하는 분들이 가끔 있다”고 했다. “지방자치 단체장들이 ‘왜 우리 동네는 안 되는 거야’ 이런 지적을 받다 보니 스트레스받는 경우도 있는 것 같다. 그렇더라도 분열적으로 접근하면 안 된다”면서 “선물 나눠주는 게 아니다”라고도 했다.)

During a meeting of senior secretaries held at the Blue House that afternoon, President Lee stated, "In the 1970s, the Park Chung-hee administration opened the path of export-driven industrialization by fostering heavy and chemical industries, and in the 2000s, the Kim Dae-jung administration paved the way for IT technology supremacy." He added, "(The 800 trillion won investment in Honam semiconductors and other) 'Three Mega Projects' will become the third stepping stone for South Korea to stand tall as a super-gap industrial powerhouse." (이날 오후 청와대에서 열린 수석보좌관 회의에서 이 대통령은 “1970년대 박정희 정부는 중화학 공업 육성으로 수출입국의 길을 열었고 2000년대 김대중 정부는 IT 기술 대국의 길을 닦았다”며 “(호남 반도체 800조원 투자 등) ‘3대 메가 프로젝트’는 대한민국이 초격차 산업 강국으로 우뚝 서는 세 번째 디딤돌이 될 것”이라고 했다.)

item.title: Dispute Over Baejae High School Discipline: Ruling Party Says "Disband the Baseball Team," Opposition Says "Blocking Kids' Futures" (배재고 징계 놓고… 與 “야구부 없애라” 野 “애들 앞길 막아”)
item.description:
Dispute Over Baejae High School Discipline: Ruling Party Says "Disband the Baseball Team," Opposition Says "Blocking Kids' Futures" (배재고 징계 놓고… 與 “야구부 없애라” 野 “애들 앞길 막아”)

Controversy is spreading to the political arena after Baejae High School's baseball team was slapped with a six-month suspension for chanting "Let's go to Starbucks" toward Gwangju Jeil High School players during a high school baseball game. The People Power Party and other opposition parties argue, "While it wasn't the right behavior, should a severe punishment also block the futures of high school players?" In contrast, the Democratic Party has even gone so far as to call for considering the disbandment of the baseball team. After Baejae High School faced criticism that the "Let's go to Starbucks" chant evoked controversy over Starbucks' May 18 "Tank Day" event, the school apologized through its website and other channels. <<> People Power Party floor leader Jeong Jeom-sik said on Facebook on the 1st, "Many players didn't join in the mockery, so a six-month suspension for the entire Baejae High School baseball team is excessive." Reform Party leader Lee Jun-seok also argued for the withdrawal of the punishment, stating, "The actions of some Baejae students deserve criticism, but if it's harsher than necessary, that's also unjust." <<> In the education sector, there are predictions that this punishment will negatively impact Baejae High School players' college admissions and advancement to professional teams. Independent lawmaker Han Dong-hoon pointed out the severity of the punishment, saying, "Broadcaster Choi Wook, who said on air that they should be 'crushed with a tank,' only apologized and is still broadcasting, and Starbucks wasn't shut down for business." People Power Party lawmaker Kim Ki-hyun said, "It's right to reconsider the six-month suspension measure," adding, "Respect isn't achieved through forcing uniform thinking or by creating a sanctified atmosphere with 'shut up and punish' tactics." <<> Democratic Party lawmaker Kim Jun-hyuk said at a press conference at the National Assembly on the 2nd, "The principal, who instilled far-right and New Right ideologies in students, leading them to wrong actions, should take full responsibility for this incident and resign immediately." Democratic Party lawmaker Lee Gae-ho said in a statement released the previous day, "The actions of the offending students should be treated as a serious case of school violence and punished strictly without exception," adding, "To uproot repeated anti-historical hateful behavior, we must thoroughly consider even disbanding the school's baseball team." Democratic Party senior lawmaker Moon Jung-bok said, "The Democratic Party will fulfill its institutional responsibility to protect the truth of the May 18 Democratization Movement and prevent distorted historical perceptions from taking root in the educational field." (고교 야구 경기 도중 광주제일고 선수들을 향해 “스타벅스 가야지” 구호를 외친 배재고 야구부에 ‘6개월 출전 정지’ 징계가 내려지자 논란이 정치권으로 확산하고 있다. 국민의힘 등 야권은 “올바른 행동은 아니지만 중징계로 고교 선수의 앞길까지 막아서야 되겠느냐”고 했다. 반면 더불어민주당에선 야구부 해체를 검토해야 한다는 주장까지 나왔다. 배재고 측은 “스타벅스 가야지” 구호가 지난 5월 스타벅스의 ‘5·18 탱크데이’ 이벤트 논란을 연상시킨다는 지적을 받자 학교 홈페이지 등을 통해 사과했었다.)

item.title: Democratic Party's Approval Rating Plummets Among 2030s... Now Finally Looking at the Youth (2030 지지율 추락… 이제서야 청년 바라보는 민주당)
item.description:
Democratic Party's Approval Rating Plummets Among 2030s... Now Finally Looking at the Youth (2030 지지율 추락… 이제서야 청년 바라보는 민주당)

With the noticeable exodus of support from the 2030 demographic for the government and ruling party since the June 3 local elections, belated voices of self-reflection are emerging within the ruling bloc. The issue of young voters defecting had been repeatedly raised around the time of the 2019 "Cho Kuk incident" during each election, but the Democratic Party had not actively engaged in thorough analysis of the causes. Within the party, some are now saying, following these local elections, "If things continue like this, we can't even guarantee the outcomes of the 2028 general election and the 2030 presidential election." <<> President Lee Jae-myung said at a senior secretary meeting on the 2nd, "Please make every effort to efficiently utilize the anticipated additional tax revenue to create stable investment funds for future generations." This was interpreted as an instruction to find ways to use the extra corporate tax revenue from the semiconductor boom for youth-related budgets. President Lee added, "The presidential office and the government must prioritize the maintenance of related policies and laws, as well as budget allocation, as top national priorities and accelerate project progress," urging, "Let’s join forces on this path that will take responsibility for the next 30 years of the Republic of Korea and open greater windows of opportunity for all young people nationwide." <<> Contenders for the Democratic Party leadership are also sending messages aimed at the youth. Former Party Leader Chung Cheong-rae, former Prime Minister Kim Min-seok, and lawmaker Song Young-gil all attended a workshop for elected young party members held in Gwangju, Gyeonggi Province, on the 28th of last month. Former Leader Chung said, "Our unified goal is for young politicians to receive good evaluations locally." Former Prime Minister Kim stated at his resignation ceremony on the 1st, "Tasks like improving the lives of young people and region-led growth will continue to be addressed within the party and the National Assembly." Lawmaker Song remarked, "This party convention should be a place to gather wisdom in solving the life problems of the 2030 generation and the hardships of small business owners." Lawmaker Kim Young-ho, running for a supreme council seat, proposed the establishment of a "Youth Sentiment Recovery Task Force (TF)" as a campaign pledge. <<> The recent decline in the ruling party's approval rating among the 2030 demographic is clearly evident in various opinion polls. According to a survey by Realmeter and Energy Economy News, the approval rating, which was 27.6% (20s) and 49.5% (30s) in the fourth week of March, plummeted to 23.3% (20s) and 23.5% (30s) just three months later, in the fourth week of June. This figure falls significantly short of the overall average approval rating of 41% across all age groups. The presidential approval rating shows a similar trend (for details, refer to the National Election Survey Deliberation Committee). Some within the party analyze that "the result of effectively ignoring the youth due to their low proportion of party members is now showing up in local elections and opinion polls." Among Democratic Party paid members (as of 2023), those in their 20s and 30s account for only 17.5% of the total. <<> At a forum titled "Why Don't the 2030s Support the Democratic Party," held by the party on the 1st, a barrage of harsh criticisms emerged. One sentiment was that "For the 2030s, the Democratic Party is an entrenched elite that creates and neglects disparities, a hypocritical force that climbs the ladder of social mobility and then kicks it away." <<> Kim Hyung-nam, a former candidate in the Seoul mayoral primary in his 30s, stated, "It's time to decide whether we will spend the entire term competing over who is more sincere about abolishing the prosecution's supplementary investigative powers, or whether we will compete over who can better show the nation the Democratic Party will build ten years from now." <<> It was also pointed out that the 2030 exodus became entrenched after the so-called "Cho Kuk incident," which triggered feelings of "unfairness" among young people due to his child's school admission scandal, but there has been no self-reflection on this. Yoon Hee-woong, CEO of Opinions, said, "In the past, the formula that 2030s are progressive, 40s are moderate, and 5060s are conservative used to work, but now it has completely changed," adding, "Looking at the trends from the 2021 Seoul mayoral by-election, the 2022 presidential election, subsequent elections, and now this local election, this is not a temporary phenomenon." Bong Geon-woo, chairman of the Democratic Party's National University Student Committee, said, "The Democratic Party, during both the Cho Kuk incident and the insurrection (referring to Yoon Seok-youl's martial law declaration), only kept repeating, 'How can you support the People Power Party?'" <<> Jeong Hye-kyung, chair of the party's policy committee, who attended the forum, said, "We deny it, but it seems the Democratic Party, which is already part of the establishment, is still denying that fact." Chief Policy Coordinator Kim Han-gyu also said, "After the defeat in the 2021 by-elections, we held meetings and forums on the same topic as now, but five years have passed without much changing." (6·3 지방선거를 기점으로 정부·여당에 대한 2030 지지세 이탈 현상이 두드러지자 여권 내 뒤늦은 반성의 목소리가 나오고 있다. 청년층 이탈 문제는 2019년 조국 사태를 전후해 선거 때마다 반복적으로 제기돼 왔지만, 그동안 민주당은 제대로 된 원인 분석 등에 적극적으로 나서지 않았었다. 민주당에선 이번 지방선거를 계기로 “이대로 가다간 2028년 총선과 2030년 대선 결과도 장담할 수 없다”는 말까지 나온다.)

item.title: New 3,600-ton Submarine's Second Ship Named 'ROKS Seo Hu' (3600t급 신형 잠수함 2번함은 ‘서희함’)
item.description:
New 3,600-ton Submarine's Second Ship Named 'ROKS Seo Hu' (3600t급 신형 잠수함 2번함은 ‘서희함’)

The Navy announced on the 3rd that the name of the second ship of the Jang Yeong-sil-class submarine (3,600-ton class) has been designated as 'ROKS Seo Hu.' Additionally, the name of the fifth new frigate (3,600-ton class) has been set as 'ROKS Pyeongtaek.' (해군은 장영실함급 잠수함(3600t급) 2번함 함명을 ‘서희함’으로 제정했다고 3일 밝혔다. 또 신형 호위함(3600t급) 5번함의 함명은 ‘평택함’으로 정했다.)

The Navy selects submarine names from figures who have contributed to military power, maritime power, scientific and technological development, as well as resistance against foreign forces and independence movements, earning national respect. Frigates are named after metropolitan cities, provinces, provincial capital locations, or mid-sized and small cities. (해군은 군사력·해양력·과학기술 발전 및 외세항쟁·독립운동 등에 기여해 국민적 존경을 받는 인물을 잠수함 함명으로 선정하고 있다. 호위함은 광역 시도나 도청 소재지, 중·소 도시의 이름으로 정하고 있다.)

'Seo Hu' (Seo Hui), chosen as the name for the second new submarine, is a figure from the Goryeo Dynasty who repelled the Khitan invasion and secured the territory of six eastern districts south of the Amnok River. The Navy stated, "We judged that the outstanding military and diplomatic achievements of the renowned prime minister Seo Hui, along with his spirit of overcoming national crises, are suitable as the name for a submarine, a key force in maritime defense." (신형 잠수함 2번함의 함명으로 명명된 ‘서희(徐熙)’는 고려시대에 거란의 침략을 막아내고 압록강 이남 강동 6주의 영토를 확보한 인물이다. 해군은 “명재상 서희의 탁월한 군사·외교적 업적과 국난 극복의 정신이 해양 수호의 핵심 전력인 잠수함의 함명으로 적합하다고 판단했다”고 밝혔다.)

'ROKS Pyeongtaek,' the fifth new frigate, takes its name from Pyeongtaek City, the location of the Navy's Second Fleet Command. The Navy explained that considerations included that the Pyeongtaek will be deployed to the Second Fleet for future missions and that Pyeongtaek is the site of a key naval base for defending the West Sea. (신형 호위함 5번함인 ‘평택함’은 해군 제2함대사령부의 소재지인 평택시의 이름을 땄다. 해군은 향후 평택함이 2함대에 배치돼 임무를 수행하게 될 예정이라는 점, 평택이 서해 수호의 핵심 해군기지 소재지라는 점 등을 고려했다고 설명했다.)

The submarine ROKS Seo Hu, currently under construction, is scheduled to be delivered to the Navy in 2028, while the frigate ROKS Pyeongtaek is expected to be delivered in 2027. (현재 건조 중인 잠수함 서희함은 2028년, 호위함 평택함은 2027년에 해군으로 인도될 예정이다.)

item.title: Jeong Jeom-sik: "The Judiciary Committee Controlled by the Opposition Has Degraded into a 'Dead Judiciary Committee' Where the Rule of Law Has Perished" (정점식 “與 장악한 법사위, 법치주의 사망한 법死위로 전락”)
item.description:
Jeong Jeom-sik: "The Judiciary Committee Controlled by the Opposition Has Degraded into a 'Dead Judiciary Committee' Where the Rule of Law Has Perished" (정점식 “與 장악한 법사위, 법치주의 사망한 법死위로 전락”)

Jeong Jeom-sik, the floor leader of the People Power Party, stated on the 3rd regarding the Democratic Party of Korea's push to expedite the processing of a revision to the Criminal Procedure Act to abolish the prosecution's supplementary investigative authority, "The Judiciary Committee, dominated by the Democratic Party, has degraded into a 'dead Judiciary Committee' (using the character for death), where the rule of law has perished." <<> During a party leadership meeting that morning, Floor Leader Jeong said, "Intoxicated by the cheers of hardline supporters, lawmaker Seo Young-kyo and the Democratic Party's Judiciary Committee members will brutally slash the rule of law with the blade of power." He added, "The Democratic Party mistakenly believes the Judiciary Committee is a stage to mutilate the judicial system to suit the tastes of their hardline supporters," and "If a judicial upheaval accelerates after the party convention, I hope they clearly remember that all responsibility lies with the government and the ruling party." <<> Regarding the Democratic Party's formation of a task force (TF) for the Criminal Procedure Act revision, he said, "If investigation and indictment are completely separated and even the supplementary investigative authority is abolished, endless case ping-pong between investigative agencies will increase, which will be entirely transferred as suffering to the victims." He continued, "If it were otherwise, why would the advisory committee for the Lee Jae-myung government's prosecution reform task force and Lee Jae-myung himself have insisted on maintaining the prosecutor's supplementary investigative authority?" <<> Meanwhile, regarding Samsung and SK's announcement of a new semiconductor plant project in Gwangju and South Jeolla Province, which faced opposition from Samsung Electronics' labor union and minority shareholder groups, Floor Leader Jeong stated, "The legal basis for a union to demand consultation on a company's investment decisions is clear. It's the 'Yellow Envelope Law.'" He added, "This is how the Yellow Envelope Law and the stricter Commercial Act, which the Lee Jae-myung government and the Democratic Party forced through, have shackled the Gwangju-Jeonnam semiconductor cluster." (정점식 국민의힘 원내대표는 3일 더불어민주당 주도로 국회 법제사법위원회가 검찰의 보완수사권 폐지를 위한 형사소송법 개정안 처리에 속도를 내는 것에 대해 “민주당이 장악한 법사위는 죽을 사(死)자를 써서 법치주의가 사망한 법사(死)위로 전락했다”고 했다.)

item.title: Kim Min-seok: President's Facial Expression Unmanageable Over Local Election Results (김민석 “이 대통령, 지방선거 결과에 표정관리 안 될 정도”)
item.description:
Kim Min-seok: President's Facial Expression Unmanageable Over Local Election Results (김민석 “이 대통령, 지방선거 결과에 표정관리 안 될 정도”)

Former Prime Minister Kim Min-seok said on the 3rd regarding the June 3 local election results, "The President was unable to control his facial expression to the point where it was noticeable." After resigning as Prime Minister on the 1st, he returned to the Democratic Party and effectively formalized his candidacy for the party leadership. (김민석 전 국무총리는 3일 6·3 지방선거 결과와 관련, “대통령께서 표정 관리가 안 될 정도였다”고 했다. 그는 지난 1일 총리직 사퇴 후 민주당으로 돌아와 사실상 당대표 선거 출마를 공식화했다.)

In a CBS radio interview that day, Kim said that President Lee Jae-myung issued the first 'apology to the nation' immediately after the election, and then targeting another party leadership contender, former Democratic Party leader Chung Cheong-rae, he stated, "The party must undergo major innovation." (김 전 총리는 이날 CBS 라디오 인터뷰에서 이재명 대통령이 선거 직후에 가장 먼저 ‘대국민 사과’를 했다고 한 뒤 또 다른 당권 주자인 정청래 전 민주당 대표를 겨냥해 “당이 대대적인 혁신을 해야 한다”고 했다.)

Regarding the past year under former Representative Chung's leadership of the Democratic Party, Kim said, "The election results serve as a certain evaluation of those outcomes," adding, "In terms of coordination with the government and relations with the opposition party, it was somewhat insufficient." (김 전 총리는 정 전 대표가 이끈 민주당의 지난 1년에 대해 “그 결과에 대한 일정한 평가를 선거를 통해 내려주신 것”이라며 “정부와의 호흡, 야당과의 관계 등에 있어 다소 미흡했다”고 했다.)

Kim said, "When the President and the government discuss matters in cabinet meetings, there needs to be a sense of pace and comprehensive integration to systematically organize and push forward whether it will be realized through legislation in the National Assembly at the same speed or immediately thereafter. In that regard, I find it a bit regrettable." Citing the example of the Election Commission's shortage of ballot papers, he added, "Shouldn't the party have responded more proactively? Since the party is the center of politics, it would be better to have more tension, speed, and a sense of responsibility." (김 전 총리는 “대통령과 정부가 국무회의에서 토론하면 같은 속도로 또는 바로 이어서 국회 입법으로 실현할 것인가를 착착 정리해 끌고 가는 속도감과 전면적 결합성이 있어야 한다”며 “그런 부분에 있어서는 좀 아쉬움이 있다”고 했다.이어 선관위 투표용지 부족 사태를 예시로 들며 “당이 좀 더 적극적으로 대처했었어야 하는 것이 아니냐”라며 “정치의 중심은 당이기 때문에 긴장감과 속도감, 책임감을 더 가지는 것이 좋겠다”고도 했다.)

He also said, "Can it work if it's a ruling party and an opposition party combined, as jokingly put?" Referring to former Representative Chung and lawmaker Song Young-gil, he said, "The two of you have already served as party leaders, whereas I haven't yet. Considering that I am the only person in the current party who has directly overseen and led general elections, presidential elections, and local elections to victory, I think I have my own usefulness." (그러면서 “흔히 농처럼 이야기하는 집권 야당이어서 되겠는가”라고도 했다. 정 전 대표와 송영길 의원을 향해서는 “두 분은 당 대표를 이미 해보셨고 저는 아직 안 해봤지 않나”라며 “현재 당내에서 총선, 대선, 지선을 다 직접 총괄·지휘해보고 승리까지 이끌어 본 유일한 사람이라는 점에서 제가 가진 나름의 쓸모가 있는 것 아닌가 생각한다”고 했다.)

Regarding the timing of his declaration to run for party leader, Kim said, "I will be able to announce that definitively soon." When asked about the recent opinion polls showing him leading among next-generation party leadership candidates, he said, "I believe this reflects the judgments and expectations of party supporters and the public regarding the direction of the party that I am proposing. I will take responsibility and do better." (김 전 총리는 당 대표 출마 선언 시점에 대해서는 “곧 확정적으로 말씀드릴 수 있을 것”이라고 했다. 최근 차기 당권주자 관련 여론조사에서 우세한 흐름을 보이고 있다는 지적엔 “제가 말씀드리고 있는 당의 방향으로 당이 변해야 한다는 것에 대한 당원 지지층, 또 국민 여러분의 판단이라든가 기대가 반영되는 것이라고 생각된다”며 “책임감을 갖고 더 잘해가겠다”고 했다.)

item.title: People Power Party: "Election Commission Drafted 'Organization Preservation' Document Amid Special Committee Probe… Wi Cheol-hwan Must Make a Decision" (국힘 “선관위, 국조특위 와중에 ‘조직 보전’ 문건…魏 거취 결단해야“)
item.description:
The People Power Party (PPP) stated on the 3rd that, as it was revealed the National Election Commission (NEC) had drafted a response document containing reasons why acting NEC Chairperson Wi Cheol-hwan (standing commissioner) should not resign, "The public hoped for reflection and reform, but what the NEC prioritized first was not reform, but 'positions.'" It added, "Acting Chair Wi must make a decision, even now." (국민의힘은 3일 중앙선거관리위원회가 위철환 중앙선거관리위원장 직무대행(상임위원)이 사퇴해선 안 되는 이유를 담은 대응 문건을 작성한 것으로 드러나자 “국민은 반성과 쇄신을 기대했지만, 선관위가 가장 먼저 챙긴 것은 개혁이 아니라 ‘자리’였다”고 했다. 그러면서 “위 직무대행은 지금이라도 결단하라”고 했다.)

PPP Chief Deputy Spokesperson Choe Eun-seok issued a commentary, stating, "It has been revealed that the NEC drafted a response document aimed at retaining all NEC commissioners, including acting Chair Wi Cheol-hwan," and added, "This shows they turned a deaf ear to the public's voice and focused solely on preserving the organization." (국민의힘 최은석 원내수석대변인은 이날 논평을 내고 “중앙선관위가 위철환 직무대행을 비롯한 선관위원 전원의 유임을 목표로 한 대응 문건을 작성한 것으로 드러났다”며 “국민 목소리에 귀를 닫고 조직 보전에만 몰두한 것”이라고 했다.)

Earlier, this newspaper reported on the same day that the NEC had drafted a document rejecting acting Chair Wi's resignation. According to a document secured by lawmaker Kim Eun-hye's office, concerns about 'weakened accountability' were raised if commissioners resigned, and 'retaining all commissioners,' including acting Chair Wi, was presented as a countermeasure. Separately, it was confirmed that three days after President Lee Jae-myung ordered a joint prosecution-police probe into the NEC, the NEC formed a response task force (TF) of 16 members in three teams. (앞서 본지는 이날 중앙선관위가 위 직무대행의 사퇴 거부 문건을 작성한 사실을 보도했다. 김은혜 의원실이 확보한 문건에는 위원 사퇴 시 ‘책임성 약화’가 문제라며, 위 직무대행을 비롯한 선관위원 ‘전원 유임’을 대응 방안으로 제시한 것으로 나타났다. 이와 별개로 이재명 대통령이 선관위에 대한 검경 합동 수사를 지시한 지 3일 후 중앙선관위가 3팀 16명 규모로 대응 태스크포스(TF)를 꾸린 사실도 확인됐다.)

In response, Chief Deputy Spokesperson Choe said, "What the NEC first created was not a reform roadmap, but a 'bulletproof strategy' for the NEC," adding, "It has become clear that under the Wi Cheol-hwan system, no further self-cleansing ability or fundamental reform can be expected from the NEC." (이에 대해 최 원내수석대변인은 “선관위가 가장 먼저 만든 것은 개혁 로드맵이 아니라 선관위 ‘방탄 전략’이었다”며 “위철환 체제에서는 더 이상 선관위의 어떠한 자정 능력도, 근본적인 개혁도 기대하기 어렵다는 사실이 명백해졌다”고 했다.)

He continued, "Acting Chair Wi Cheol-hwan must make a decision, even now. His position must no longer be an obstacle to NEC reform," and said, "The PPP will actively pursue all means, including a special counsel recommended by the opposition party, and will hold those responsible for this incident—including impeachment of acting Chair Wi—fully accountable, both politically and legally." (그러면서 “위철환 직무대행은 지금이라도 결단하라. 더 이상 본인의 거취가 선관위 개혁의 걸림돌이 되어서는 안 된다”며 “국민의힘은 야당 추천 특검을 비롯한 모든 수단을 적극 추진하고, 위 직무대행에 대한 탄핵을 포함해 이번 사태의 책임자들에게 정치적·법적 책임을 끝까지 묻겠다”고 했다.)

PPP Spokesperson Cho Yong-sul also stated in a commentary, "Is Wi Cheol-hwan's stubbornness over a dissolution-level reform of the NEC even plausible?" Cho said, "Public calls are growing to reform the NEC at a dissolution level due to restrictions on voting rights and poor election management," adding, "Yet, the NEC leaders seem solely focused on holding onto their posts." (국민의힘 조용술 대변인도 이날 논평에서 “해체 수준의 선관위 개혁, 위철환 버티기가 가당키나 하느냐”고 했다. 조 대변인은 “참정권 제한과 부실한 선거 관리로 선관위를 해체 수준으로 개혁하라는 국민적 요구가 거세지고 있다”며 “그런데도 선관위 책임자들은 자리 지키기에만 급급한 모습”이라고 했다.)

Referencing the response document drafted by the NEC, he said, "The most absurd part of the response document is the logic that 'a commissioner resigning would weaken accountability.' If the achievement of the NEC, which should have the highest accountability, is mismanagement, then such a sense of responsibility is unwelcome," and added, "Acting Chair Wi Cheol-hwan, the core figure responsible for this incident, should stop clinging to his position and first take responsibility before the people." (그는 선관위가 작성한 대응 문건을 거론하며 “대응 문건에서 가장 황당한 것은 ‘위원이 사퇴하면 책임성이 약화된다’는 논리다. 누구보다 책임성이 높아야 할 선관위의 업적이 부실 관리라면 그런 책임감은 사양하겠다”라며 “이번 사태의 핵심 책임자인 위철환 직무대행은 더 이상 자리 보전에 연연할 것이 아니라 국민 앞에 책임부터 져야 한다”고 했다.)

item.title: White House: “Lee Jae-myung Administration Singling Out Coupang… Will Not Tolerate Unfair Trade Practices” (백악관 “이재명 정부, 쿠팡 표적 삼아… 불공정 관행 용납하지 않을 것”)
item.description:
White House: “Lee Jae-myung Administration Singling Out Coupang… Will Not Tolerate Unfair Trade Practices” (백악관 “이재명 정부, 쿠팡 표적 삼아… 불공정 관행 용납하지 않을 것”)

As the U.S. House Judiciary Committee released an interim report on Wednesday regarding Coupang’s personal data leak controversy, accusing the South Korean government of “discrimination,” the White House told this newspaper on Thursday that “by any reasonable measures, Coupang is being singled out by the Lee Jae-myung administration” and that “the Trump administration will not tolerate unfair trade practices, including actions that restrict U.S. digital services’ access to the Korean market.” A White House official stated, “The U.S. government is deeply concerned that the Korean government is discriminately targeting U.S. tech companies.” (미국 하원 법사위원회가 1일 개인 정보 유출이 문제가 된 쿠팡과 관련해 중간 보고서를 발표해 한국 정부가 ‘차별’을 하고 있다고 주장한 가운데, 백악관은 2일 본지에 “어떤 합리적은 기준을 적용하더라도(by any reasonable measures) 쿠팡은 이재명 정부에 의해 표적으로 지목되고(being singled out) 있다”며 “트럼프 정부는 미국 디지털 서비스의 한국 시장 접근을 제한하는 행위를 포함한 불공정 무역 관행을 용납하지 않을 것”이라고 했다. 백악관 관계자는 이날 “미 정부는 한국 정부가 미국 테크 기업을 차별적으로 표적 삼고 있는 상황에 대해 깊은 우려를 표명(deeply concerned)한다”며 이같이 밝혔다.)

According to a fact sheet jointly released by South Korea and the U.S. in November last year, “the United States and the Republic of Korea ensure that companies of either Party are not discriminated against or subjected to unnecessary barriers with respect to laws and policies related to digital services, including network usage fees and online platform regulations.” The U.S. Trade Representative (USTR) did not respond to this newspaper’s inquiry regarding this report. Rep. Darrell Issa (R-CA), who led the sending of a letter from the Republican Study Committee (RSC) to Korean Ambassador to the U.S. Cho Hyun-dong, called the report “a bombshell,” saying, “Targeting U.S. companies and U.S. citizens is not how you treat a friend.” Rep. Adrian Smith (R-NE), chairman of the House Ways and Means Trade Subcommittee, said, “We can no longer tolerate discriminatory actions against U.S. companies.” (한미가 지난해 11월 발표한 팩트시트(Fact Sheet·공동 설명 자료)를 보면 “망 사용료, 온라인플랫폼 규제를 포함한 디지털 서비스 관련 법과 정책에 있어서 미 기업들이 차별당하거나 불필요한 장벽에 직면하지 않도록 한미가 보장한다”고 돼 있다. USTR은 이번 보고서에 대한 입장을 묻는 본지 질의에 응답하지 않았다. 앞서 강경화 주미대사를 수신인으로 하는 공화당 연구위원회(RSC) 서한 발송을 주도한 데럴 아이사 하원의원은 “이번 보고서는 폭탄(bombshell) 같은 내용”이라며 “미국 기업을 표적 삼고 미국 시민을 겨냥하는 방식은 친구를 대하는 모습이 아니다”라고 했다. 하원 세입위 무역소위원장인 이에드리언 스미스 공화당 의원은 “미국 기업에 대한 차별적 행위를 더 이상 견딜 수 없다”고 했다.)

Fred Fleitz, Vice President of the America First Policy Institute (AFPI) and former chief of staff at the National Security Council (NSC) during the first Trump administration, said, “It’s shocking that the South Korean government forced Coupang to secretly send divers to recover laptops from a Chinese river.” Former Rep. Chris Stewart (R-UT), a six-term congressman from Utah, said, “I never expected a long-time ally to borrow strategies from Beijing (China) and called on Congress to take action to protect U.S. companies.” The Fair Market Alliance for America and Asia (FMA), led by Matt Mowers, former White House advisor and chief of staff at the State Department’s Office of the Global AIDS Coordinator (S/GAC) during the first Trump administration, said, “Within an opaque regulatory system, Korean authorities have treated U.S. companies differently from their domestic and regional competitors,” adding, “Non-tariff barriers can be as harmful as tariffs.” (트럼프 1기 때 국가안보회의(NSC) 비서실장을 지낸 프레드 플라이츠 미국우선주의정책연구소(AFPI) 부소장은 “한국 정부가 쿠팡을 강제해 중국 강에서 노트북을 회수하기 위해 몰래 잠수부를 보낸 건 충격적인 일”이라고 했다. 유타주(州)에서 6선(選)을 한 크리스 스튜어트 전 공화당 하원의원도 “오랜 동맹이 ‘베이징(중국)’의 전략을 빌려 쓰는 모습을 결코 예상하지 못했다”며 “의회가 미국 기업을 보호하기 위한 행동에 나서야 한다”고 했다. 트럼프 1기 백악관 고문, 국무부 글로벌에이즈조정관실(S/GAC) 비서실장을 지낸 맷 모어스가 이끄는 ‘미국·아시아 공정시장 연대(FMA)’는 “불투명한 규제 시스템 속에서 한국 당국이 미 기업에 국내·지역 경쟁자들과 다른 차별적인 대우를 했다”며 “비관세 장벽은 관세만큼이나 해로울 수 있다”고 했다.)

()

◇ “Cut Off Mid-Answer, Lawmaker Used Profanity” (◇ “답변도 전에 말 끊고 의원이 ‘개XX’ 욕설’”)

The report particularly focuses on a hearing held in December last year by the National Assembly’s Science, ICT, Broadcasting, and Communications Committee, where Harold Rogers, interim head of Coupang’s South Korean entity, testified. During the session, some Democratic Party of Korea lawmakers went beyond questioning, with one saying, “A club isn’t even enough” (Rep. Kim Young-bae), and another using profanity (Rep. Cho Il-chul). It is known that the reaction in U.S. political circles to this hearing was decisive in escalating the Coupang issue into a bilateral trade matter. While it is common in the U.S. Congress to summon corporate executives causing social controversy for lawmakers to grill them, instances of going beyond harsh criticism to outright profanity are rare. Lawmakers yelling and not giving proper opportunities to respond, coupled with a “Korean-style hearing” aimed at producing short-form videos (shorts) to cater to supporters, inevitably feels foreign in comparison. (이번 보고서는 특히 지난해 12월 해럴드 로저스 쿠팡 한국법인 임시 대표가 출석한 국회 과학기술정보방송통신위원회 청문회를 주요하게 다루고 있다. 당시 더불어민주당 일부 의원은 문제 제기를 넘어 “몽둥이도 모자란다”(김영배 의원)라고 강하게 질타하고 욕설(조일출 의원)까지 했는데, 쿠팡 문제가 한미 간 통상 현안으로까지 비화한 데는 이 청문회에 대한 미 조야(朝野)의 반응이 결정적이었던 것으로 알려져 있다. 미 의회에서도 사회적 물의를 일으킨 기업인을 소환해 의원들이 추궁하는 경우가 다반사지만, 원색적인 비난을 넘어 욕설까지 하는 경우는 찾아보기 힘들다. 의원이 윽박지르고 답변할 기회도 제대로 주지 않는 한편, 지지층을 의식한 ‘쇼츠(shorts)’ 양산을 목표로 하는 ‘한국식(式) 청문회’가 그만큼 생경하게 다가올 수 밖에 없다.)

The Judiciary Committee, which called Rogers for a seven-hour testimony in February, stated that “Rogers received over 20 threats of personal criminal prosecution, including perjury charges, arrest, travel bans, and forced deportation, on just the first day of the hearing.” The report also noted that even before any formal investigation, some lawmakers called for Coupang’s bankruptcy, the passage of bills to shut down Coupang, and repeatedly referred to the company as an “organized crime group” and “mafia.” The report said, “Rogers did not get the opportunity to answer questions raised by lawmakers.” In particular, it stated that “Rogers heard profanity equivalent to ‘mother F’er’ in Korean and was called a liar during the hearing.” Footage captured Rep. Cho Il-chul cutting off Rogers several times even when Rogers insisted on finishing his answer, closing his questioning with profanity. Regarding Coupang founder Bom Kim, the term “dark-haired foreigner” was used, which the report described as “a derogatory term for someone born in Korea but later acquiring citizenship in another country.” (지난 2월 로저스를 불러 7시간 증언을 청취한 법사위는 “위증죄 고발, 체포, 출국 금지, 강제 추방 등 로저스가 청문회 첫날에만 개인적인 형사 고발을 당할 것이란 위협을 20회 이상 받았다”고 했다. 정식 조사가 이뤄지기도 전에 일부 의원이 쿠팡 파산, 쿠팡 폐업을 위한 법안 통과를 요구하고 쿠팡을 ‘조직범죄 집단’ ‘마피아’라 여러 차례 지칭한 것도 보고서에 담겼다. 보고서는 “로저스가 의원들이 제기한 질문에 답변할 기회를 얻지 못했다”고 했다. 특히 “청문회에서 한국어로 ‘개XX(mother F’er)’에 해당하는 욕설을 듣고 거짓말쟁이라 불렸다”고 했는데, 조 의원은 “대답을 마저 하겠다”는 로저스 주장에도 불구하고 이를 여러 차례 끊더니 자신의 질의 말미에 욕설을 하는 모습이 카메라에 잡혔다. 쿠팡 창업자인 범 김(Bom Kim·한국 이름 김범석)에 대해선 ‘검은 머리 외국인(dark-haired foreigner)’라고 했는데, 보고서는 이를 두고 “한국에서 태어났으나 이후 다른 나라 시민권을 취득한 사람을 비하하는 용어”라고 했다.)

()

◇ Zero Input from Korean Government… Revealed Lobbying Capabilities in U.S. (◇ 의견 한 줄 반영 안 돼… 드러난 對美로비 실력)

While Foreign Ministry spokesperson Park In expressed regret on Thursday during a regular briefing, stating the report “one-sidedly reflects only Coupang’s claims,” there is criticism of a total failure in lobbying the U.S., as the Korean government failed to get even a single line of its views reflected despite spending substantial sums hiring lobbyists like law firms and consultants. A multinational law firm partner in Washington DC said, “Even universities and law firms that Trump lambasts as ‘radical left’ hire lobbyists with connections to key figures to convey their arguments and push them through—that’s the rule of the game,” adding, “Constantly talking about ‘Coupang’s lobbying’ to target domestic public opinion with negative perceptions of lobbying itself hasn’t solved a single problem.” The South Korean Embassy in the U.S. hires top-tier law firms such as Brownstein Hyatt Farber Schreck, Arnold & Porter, and Akin Gump Strauss Hauer & Feld, paying hundreds of millions of won annually in retainers. (박일 외교부 대변인은 2일 정례 브리핑에서 이번 보고서에 대해 “쿠팡 측 주장만을 일방적으로 반영하고 있다”며 유감을 표시했지만, 로펌·자문사 같은 로비스트 고용에 적지 않은 돈을 쓰고도 우리 정부 의견 한 줄 반영하지 못하는 대미(對美) 로비의 총체적 실패라는 지적도 나온다. 워싱턴 DC의 한 다국적 로펌 변호사는 “트럼프가 ‘급진 좌파’라 쏘아붙이는 대학, 로펌들조차 요인에 줄을 댈 수 있는 로비스트를 고용해 주장을 전달하고 이를 관철시키는 게 게임의 법칙”이라며 “로비 자체에 부정적인 인식이 강한 국내 여론을 겨냥해 만날 ‘쿠팡의 로비’ 운운해서 해결되는 문제는 하나도 없다”고 했다. 주미 한국대사관은 브라운스타인 하얏트 파버 슈렉, 아놀드 앤 포터, 에이킨 검프 스트라우스 호이어 앤 펠드 등 수준급 로펌을 고용해 수임료로 매년 수억 원씩을 지불하고 있다.)

Among these, records filed with the U.S. Department of Justice by “Thomas Capitol Partners, Inc.,” which the embassy hired as a “foreign agent” representing the Korean government’s interests, show most activities were “in-person meeting requests.” The company’s president, a Korean-American named Kim, has earned over 10 billion won in total since the mid-2000s from embassy contracts. His clients have solely been the embassy and the Korea International Trade Association (KITA), and his website has not been updated since 2016. At major receptions in Washington DC, the ambassador has often been seen accompanied by Kim. In January this year, when then-Prime Minister Kim Min-seok visited Congress for a luncheon with a U.S. House delegation, Kim was also captured on camera. A source said, “He is known for handling various ‘dirty work,’ such as hastily arranging meetings when high-ranking Korean officials visit and accompanying former and current U.S. lawmakers during their visits to Korea.” <<>> (이 가운데 주미대사관이 고용한 ‘토머스 캐피톨 파트너스(Thomas Capitol Partners, Inc.)’가 한국 정부 이익을 대변하는 ‘외국 대리인(foreign agent)’로 미 법무부에 신고한 활동 내역을 보면 다수는 ‘대면 회의 요청(In-person meeting request)’였다. 이 회사 대표인 한국계 미국인 김모씨는 2000년대 중반부터 대사관 일감을 가져가면서 도합 100억원이 넘는 돈을 받아 갔다. 그간 고객은 대사관과 한국무역협회(KITA) 뿐이고 홈페이지는 2016년 이후로 업데이트된 것이 없다. 워싱턴 DC의 주요 리셉션에선 대사가 김씨를 대동하고 다니는 모습도 종종 포착되는데, 올해 1월 김민석 당시 국무총리가 의회를 방문해 하원의원단과 오찬을 했을 때도 김씨의 모습이 카메라에 잡혔다. 한 소식통은 “한국에서 높은 분이 와서 요청이 있을 때 급하게 미팅을 잡고, 미 전·현직 의원단이 한국을 방문할 때 동행하는 등 여러 ‘궂은 일’을 도맡아 하는 것으로 알려져 있다”고 했다.)

item.title: 55% Say Home Prices Will Rise in Next Year... 46% Say Housing Policies Are Mishandled (“향후 1년간 집값 오를 것” 55%... “부동산 정책 잘못한다” 46%)
item.description:
55% Say Home Prices Will Rise in Next Year... 46% Say Housing Policies Are Mishandled (“향후 1년간 집값 오를 것” 55%... “부동산 정책 잘못한다” 46%)

Survey results show that more than half of voters believe home prices will rise over the next year. Gallup Korea announced on the 3rd that a survey of 1,005 individuals aged 18 and older nationwide, conducted from June 30 to July 2, yielded these findings. (유권자의 절반 이상이 ‘향후 1년간 집값이 오를 것’이라고 생각한다는 조사 결과가 나왔다. 한국갤럽은 6월 30일∼7월 2일 전국 만 18세 이상 1005명을 대상으로 조사한 결과, 이같이 나타났다고 3일 밝혔다.)

Regarding the outlook for real estate over the next year, 55% of respondents predicted that home prices would rise. This is a 26 percentage point increase from the 29% recorded in March. The expectation that housing rental costs, such as jeonse and monthly rent, will also rise over the next year stood at 65%, up 19 percentage points from the March survey (46%). Only 8% predicted a decline. (‘향후 1년간 부동산 전망’과 관련, 응답자의 55%가 ‘집값이 오를 것’이라고 내다봤다. 지난 3월 29%에 비해 26%포인트 높다. ‘향후 1년간 전월세 등 주택 임대료가 오를 것’이라는 전망도 65%로 지난 3월 조사(46%)에 비해 19%포인트 상승했다. ‘내릴 것’이란 전망은 8%였다.)

In evaluating housing policies, 26% of respondents said the government is doing well, a 25 percentage point drop from 51% in March. In contrast, the assessment that policies are mishandled rose by 19 percentage points from 27% in March to 46%. Gallup noted that "the positive rating for policies fell significantly among respondents in their 20s and 30s, who strongly believe in rising home and rental prices, and across most demographics, including Seoul." (부동산 정책에 대한 평가에서 ‘잘한다’는 평가를 한 응답자는 26%로 지난 3월 51%에 비해 25%포인트 감소했다. 반면 ‘잘못한다’는 평가는 지난 3월 27%에서 19%포인트 오른 46%로 조사됐다. 갤럽은 “집값·임대료 상승론이 강한 20·30대와, 서울을 비롯한 대부분 응답자 특성에서 정책 긍정률이 떨어졌다”고 했다.)

Meanwhile, regarding President Lee Jae-myung's job performance, 54% said he is doing well, and 36% said he is doing poorly. Compared to the previous survey (51%), the positive rating rose by 3 percentage points, while the negative rating fell by 5 percentage points. For party support, the Democratic Party of Korea received 41%, the People Power Party 26%, and 25% were undecided. Concerning new Prime Minister Han Seong-sook, 31% deemed her suitable, 23% unsuitable, and 46% reserved judgment. (한편 이재명 대통령 직무평가에선 ‘잘하고 있다’가 54%, ‘잘못하고 있다’가 36%로 조사됐다. 직전 조사(51%)에 비해 긍정평가가 3%포인트 올랐고, 부정평가는 5%포인트 낮아진 것이다. 정당 지지도는 더불어민주당이 41%, 국민의힘이 26%, 무당층이 25%다. 한성숙 신임 국무총리와 관련해선 ‘적합’ 평가가 31%, ‘부적합’ 23%, ‘판단 유보’ 46%로 조사됐다.)

item.title: Lee Un-ju: "Excluded from Committee Chair Assignments… Is This Political Retaliation?" (이언주 “상임위원장 배정서 제외…정치보복이냐” 반발)
item.description:
Lee Un-ju: "Excluded from Committee Chair Assignments… Is This Political Retaliation?" (이언주 “상임위원장 배정서 제외…정치보복이냐” 반발)

Lee Un-ju, a lawmaker of the Democratic Party of Korea, expressed her opposition on social media on the 3rd regarding her exclusion from the assignment of National Assembly committee chairs. She claimed that the party leadership omitted her from the list without any explanation, asking, "Is this political retaliation?" (이언주 더불어민주당 의원이 국회 상임위원장 배정에서 제외된 데 대해 3일 소셜미디어를 통해 반발했다. 이 의원은 원내지도부가 별다른 설명 없이 자신을 배정 명단에서 뺐다며 “정치 보복이냐”고 했다.)

In a Facebook post that morning, she said, "Even a neighborhood club would create an uproar if seats were allocated without reasonable criteria, but it struck me that they carved up the committee chairs—positions equivalent to minister-level roles—while excluding only me." (이 의원은 이날 오전 페이스북 글에서에 “동네 동아리 모임도 합리적 기준 없이 자리를 나누면 난리가 나는데 장관급인 국회 상임위원장을 나만 쏙 빼고 나눠먹기했다는 생각이 들었다”고 했다.)

She explained, "Traditionally, the allocation of committee chairs has followed this order: (1) those serving three or more terms, (2) ensuring each gets a turn, (3) considering expertise, and (4) promoting female representation. When there was competition, we sometimes held primaries." She added, "As a lawyer specializing in investments and coming from an industrial background, I applied for the chairs of the Industry & SMEs Committee and the Science & ICT Committee—both economic and industrial fields—and the party leadership said they would 'discuss it.' I thought I’d get at least one, but I was left out." (그는 “그동안 상임위원장 배분은 ① 3선 이상 ② 한 번씩 ③ 전문성 고려 ④ 여성배려의 순으로 해 왔고 경쟁이 있어 가끔 경선도 했다”고 설명했다.이어 “나는 투자전문 변호사이자 산업계 출신이기에 경제산업분야 위원장인 산중위원장, 과방위원장을 지원했고 원내지도부는 ‘상의하겠다’고 했다”며 “그중 하나는 되는 걸로 알고 있었는데 나는 빠져 있었다”고 했다.)

The lawmaker continued, "I asked what the criteria were, but got no answer, not even a returned call. It’s fine if I don’t become chair, but shouldn’t a legitimate party at least share responsibilities with a sense of public accountability? Is this political retaliation?" (이 의원은 “기준이 뭐냐고 물었지만 답도 없고 전화도 받지 않았다”며 “위원장 안 해도 그만이지만 최소한 공당으로서 공적 책임감은 갖고 나눠야 하지 않냐, 정치보복이냐”고 했다.)

She added, "There’s a post circulating on a community site that seems to mock me with snickers. Still, I won’t leave the party again. If they want to kick me out, let them, but I won’t walk out on my own." (그러면서 “딴지 커뮤니티에 나를 낄낄거리며 조롱하는 느낌의 글이 돌고 있다”며 “그렇다고 또다시 탈당 같은 건 안 한다. 쫓아내려면 쫓아내라, 내 발로는 안 나간다”고 했다.)

She concluded, "I’m the leading candidate representing the centrist conservatives within the Democratic Party of Korea, the 'New Lee Jae-myung.' From the time of the Cho Kuk incident, when I shaved my head, to now, I’ve consistently called for crossing 'the river of Cho Kuk,' the symbol of hypocrisy and double standards. It brings me great comfort knowing that many awakened party members now agree that I was right and stand with me." (이 의원은 “(나는) 민주당에서 중도보수를 대변하는 뉴이재명 대표주자”라며 “조국사태 당시 삭발부터 지금까지 일관되게 내로남불과 위선의 상징 ‘조국의 강’을 건너자고 했고, 지금은 내 말이 맞았다며 함께 한다는 깨어있는 당원들도 많은 것에 큰 위안을 느낀다”고 했다.)
